 * Features:
 * - Search by PAN or Customer Name

 */

api.controller = function($scope) {
    var c = this;

    // Core state
    c.data.calc             = {};
    c.data.submitted        = false;
    c.data.submitting       = false;
    c.data.saving           = false;
    c.data.searchError      = '';
    c.data.submitError      = '';
    
    // Search state
    c.data.searchTerm       = '';
    c.data.searchResults    = [];
    c.data.selectedCustomerSysId = '';
    
    // Multi-site state (Non-Trade)

    c.data.sitesTotalRequested  = 0;
    c.data.sitesValidationError = '';

    // ── Search customers (by PAN or Name) ──────────────────────
    c.onSearchChange = function() {
        c.data.searchResults = [];
        c.data.searchError   = '';
        c.data.selectedCustomerSysId = '';
        c.clearCustomerData();
    };

    c.searchCustomers = function() {
        var term = (c.data.searchTerm || '').trim();
        if (term.length < 3) {
            c.data.searchError = 'Enter at least 3 characters to search';
            return;
        }

        c.data.searchError   = '';
        c.data.searchResults = [];
        c.data.selectedCustomerSysId = '';
        
        c.server.get({ 
            action: 'searchCustomers', 
            searchTerm: term 
        }).then(function(r) {
            if (r.data.customers && r.data.customers.length > 0) {
                c.data.searchResults = r.data.customers;
                c.data.searchError   = '';
            } else {
                c.data.searchResults = [];
                c.data.searchError   = 'No customers found for "' + term + '"';
            }
        });
    };

    // ── Select customer from search results ────────────────────
    c.selectCustomer = function(cust) {
        c.data.selectedCustomerSysId = cust.sys_id;
        c.data.customerSysId   = cust.sys_id;
        c.data.customerName    = cust.customer_name;
        c.data.customerType    = cust.customer_type;
        c.data.segment         = cust.segment;
        c.data.zone            = cust.zone;
        c.data.region          = cust.region;
        c.data.pan             = cust.pan;
        c.data.cg2Code         = cust.cg2_code;
        c.data.constitution    = cust.constitution;
        c.data.isListed        = cust.is_listed;
        c.data.vintageDays     = cust.vintage_days;
        //c.data.currentLimit    = cust.current_limit / 100000;
      c.data.currentLimit = cust.current_credit_limit / 100000;  
			c.data.hierarchyLevel  = cust.hierarchy_level;
        c.data.hierarchyData   = cust.hierarchy_data;
        c.data.avgMonthlySales = cust.avg_monthly_sales;
        c.data.orderRate       = cust.order_rate || 7000;

        if (cust.outstanding > 0 && !c.data.outstanding)
            c.data.outstanding = cust.outstanding;
        
        if (cust.customer_type === 'Trade' && cust.current_sd > 0 && !c.data.activeSD)
            c.data.activeSD = cust.current_sd;
        
        if (cust.customer_type !== 'Trade')
            c.data.activeSD = 0;

        // Load sites for Non-Trade customers
        if (cust.customer_type === 'Non-Trade') {
            c.loadSites(cust.sys_id, cust.pan);
        }

        depot: cust.zone,
        site_code: cust.customer_code_sap,
        location: cust.region + ' - ' + cust.zone,
        current_limit: cust.current_credit_limit,
        outstanding: cust.outstanding,
        requested_limit: 0
    }];

        // Recalculate if limit already entered
        if (c.data.requestedLimit > 0) c.recalculate();
    };

    c.clearCustomerData = function() {
        c.data.customerSysId   = '';
        c.data.customerName    = '';
        c.data.customerType    = '';
        c.data.segment         = '';
        c.data.calc            = {};
        c.data.activeSD        = 0;
        c.data.outstanding     = 0;
        c.data.sites           = [];
        c.data.sitesCount      = 0;
        c.data.sitesTotalRequested = 0;
    };

    // ── Load sites for Non-Trade customer ──────────────────────
    c.loadSites = function(customerSysId, pan) {
        c.server.get({ 
            action: 'loadSites', 
            customerSysId: customerSysId,
            pan: pan
        }).then(function(r) {
            if (r.data.sites && r.data.sites.length > 0) {
                c.data.sites      = r.data.sites;
                c.data.sitesCount = r.data.sites.length;
                c.recalculateSites();
            } else {
                c.data.sites      = [];
                c.data.sitesCount = 0;
            }
        });
    };

    // ── Recalculate site totals ────────────────────────────────
    c.recalculateSites = function() {
        if (!c.data.sites || c.data.sites.length === 0) {
            c.data.sitesTotalRequested = 0;
            c.data.sitesCount = 0;
            return;
        }

        var total = 0;
        var count = 0;
        
        c.data.sites.forEach(function(site) {
            var req = parseFloat(site.requested_limit) || 0;
            if (req > 0) {
                total += req;
                count++;
            }
        });

        c.data.sitesTotalRequested = total / 100000; // Convert to Lakhs
        c.data.sitesCount          = count;

        // Validate: Total requested should not be 0 (No Orphan Limit Rule)
        if (c.data.sitesTotalRequested === 0) {
            c.data.sitesValidationError = 'All requested credit must be allocated to sites. Total cannot be 0.';
        } else {
            c.data.sitesValidationError = '';
        }

        // Update main requested limit for routing
        c.data.requestedLimit = total;
        
        // Recalculate routing
        c.recalculate();
    };

    // ── Live recalculate (Trade only) ──────────────────────────
    c.recalculate = function() {
        // Skip for Non-Trade (handled by site calculation)
        if (c.data.customerType === 'Non-Trade') return;
        
        var req = parseFloat(c.data.requestedLimit) || 0;
        if (req <= 0 || !c.data.customerSysId) { 
            c.data.calc = {}; 
            return; 
        }

        c.server.get({
            action: 'calculate', 
            customerType: c.data.customerType || 'Trade',
            customerSysId: c.data.customerSysId, 
            requestedLimit: req,
            activeSD: parseFloat(c.data.activeSD)||0, 
            outstanding: parseFloat(c.data.outstanding)||0,
            avgMonthlySales: parseFloat(c.data.avgMonthlySales)||0,
            salesLastMonth: parseFloat(c.data.salesLastMonth)||0, 
            salesPrevMonth: parseFloat(c.data.salesPrevMonth)||0,
            segment: c.data.segment||'Cement', 
            cg2Code: c.data.cg2Code||'', 
            vintageDays: parseInt(c.data.vintageDays)||0
        }).then(function(r) { 
            if (r.data.calc) c.data.calc = r.data.calc; 
        });
    };

    // ── Save Draft ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    c.saveDraft = function() {
        c.data.saving = true;
        c.server.get({ action: 'saveDraft', form: c.buildPayload() })
        .then(function(r) { 
            c.data.saving = false; 
            c.data.draftSysId = r.data.sysId; 
            c.data.requestNumber = r.data.number; 
        });
    };

    // ── Submit ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    c.submit = function() {
        c.data.submitError = '';
        
        if (!c.data.selectedCustomerSysId) { 
            c.data.submitError = 'Please select a customer.'; 
            return; 
        }
        if (!c.data.segment) { 
            c.data.submitError = 'Please select a segment.'; 
            return; 
        }
        if (!c.data.justification || c.data.justification.trim().length < 20) {
            c.data.submitError = 'Business justification must be at least 20 characters.'; 
            return; 
        }
        if (c.data.calc.isDeviation && (!c.data.deviationJustification || c.data.deviationJustification.trim().length < 20)) {
            c.data.submitError = 'Deviation justification is required.'; 
            return; 
        }

        // Non-Trade validation
        if (c.data.customerType === 'Non-Trade') {
            if (c.data.sitesTotalRequested === 0) {
                c.data.submitError = 'All requested credit must be allocated to sites. Total cannot be 0.';
                return;
            }
            if (c.data.sitesValidationError) {
                c.data.submitError = c.data.sitesValidationError;
                return;
            }
        }

        c.data.submitting = true;
        c.server.get({ action: 'submit', form: c.buildPayload() })
        .then(function(r) {
            c.data.submitting = false;
            if (r.data.success) {
                c.data.submitted = true; 
                c.data.requestNumber = r.data.requestNumber;
                c.data.approverRole = r.data.approverRole; 
                c.data.isDeviation = r.data.isDeviation;
            } else { 
                c.data.submitError = r.data.error || 'Submission failed.'; 
            }
        }).catch(function() { 
            c.data.submitting = false; 
            c.data.submitError = 'Server error.'; 
        });
    };

    c.resetForm = function() {
        c.data = { 
            calc: {}, 
            submitted: false, 
            submitting: false, 
            saving: false,
            searchTerm: '',
            searchResults: [],
            selectedCustomerSysId: '',
            sites: [],
            sitesCount: 0,
            sitesTotalRequested: 0
        };
    };

    c.buildPayload = function() {
        var payload = {
            customerSysId: c.data.selectedCustomerSysId, 
            customerType: c.data.customerType,
            segment: c.data.segment, 
            requestedLimit: c.data.requestedLimit,
            activeSD: c.data.activeSD||0, 
            outstanding: c.data.outstanding||0,
            avgMonthlySales: c.data.avgMonthlySales||0, 
            salesLastMonth: c.data.salesLastMonth||0,
            salesPrevMonth: c.data.salesPrevMonth||0, 
            chequeBounces: c.data.chequeBounces||0,
            marketPerception: c.data.marketPerception||'', 
            justification: c.data.justification,
            deviationJustification: c.data.deviationJustification||'',
            vintageDays: c.data.vintageDays||0, 
            draftSysId: c.data.draftSysId||''
        };

        // Add sites data for Non-Trade
        if (c.data.customerType === 'Non-Trade' && c.data.sites && c.data.sites.length > 0) {
            payload.sites = c.data.sites.map(function(s) {
                return {
                    site_code: s.site_code,
                    depot: s.depot,
                    location: s.location,
                    current_limit: parseFloat(s.current_limit) || 0,
                    outstanding: parseFloat(s.outstanding) || 0,
                    project_potential: parseFloat(s.project_potential) || 0,
                    monthly_volume: parseFloat(s.monthly_volume) || 0,
                    requested_limit: parseFloat(s.requested_limit) || 0
                };
            }).filter(function(s) { return s.requested_limit > 0; });
        }

        return payload;
    };

    <div class="clm-header-right" ng-if="c.data.requestNumber">
      <div class="clm-request-badge">{{c.data.requestNumber}}</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ── SUCCESS STATE ── -->
  <div class="clm-success-panel" ng-if="c.data.submitted">
    <div class="clm-success-icon">✓</div>
    <h3>Request Submitted Successfully</h3>
    <p>Request <strong>{{c.data.requestNumber}}</strong> has been created and routed to <strong>{{c.data.approverRole}}</strong> for approval.</p>
    <div ng-if="c.data.isDeviation" class="clm-deviation-note">
      ⚠ This is a deviation request — approval requires justification review.
    </div>
    <button class="clm-btn clm-btn-outline" ng-click="c.resetForm()">Submit Another Request</button>
  </div>

  <!-- ── MAIN FORM ── -->
  <form name="clmForm" ng-submit="c.submit()" ng-if="!c.data.submitted">

    <!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         SECTION 1: CUSTOMER SEARCH (PAN or Name)
    ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <div class="clm-section">
      <div class="clm-section-title">
        <span class="clm-section-num">1</span> Customer Search
      </div>

      <div class="clm-row">
        <div class="clm-field">
          <label>Search by PAN or Customer Name <span class="req">*</span></label>
          <div class="clm-input-group">
            <input type="text"
                   ng-model="c.data.searchTerm"
                   ng-change="c.onSearchChange()"
                   placeholder="Enter PAN (e.g., ABCDE1234Z) or Customer Name"
                   class="clm-input" required />
            <button type="button" class="clm-input-btn"
                    ng-click="c.searchCustomers()"
                    ng-disabled="!c.data.searchTerm || c.data.searchTerm.length < 3">
              Search
            </button>
          </div>
          <div class="clm-field-hint" ng-if="c.data.searchTerm && c.data.searchTerm.length < 3">
            Enter at least 3 characters to search
          </div>
          <div class="clm-field-msg clm-error" ng-if="c.data.searchError">
            {{c.data.searchError}}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Search Results (Multiple customers for same PAN) -->
      <div class="clm-search-results" ng-if="c.data.searchResults && c.data.searchResults.length > 0">
        <div class="clm-search-results-title">
          Found {{c.data.searchResults.length}} customer(s)
          <span ng-if="c.data.searchResults[0].pan"> for PAN: <strong>{{c.data.searchResults[0].pan}}</strong></span>
        </div>
        
        <div class="clm-search-grid">
          <div ng-repeat="cust in c.data.searchResults" 
               class="clm-search-card"
               ng-class="{'clm-search-card-selected': c.data.selectedCustomerSysId == cust.sys_id}"
               ng-click="c.selectCustomer(cust)">
            
            <div class="clm-search-card-header">
              <span class="clm-search-card-name">{{cust.customer_name}}</span>
              <span class="clm-search-card-badge"
                    ng-class="{
                      'clm-badge-cement': cust.segment == 'Cement',
                      'clm-badge-rmc': cust.segment == 'RMC',
                      'clm-badge-bpd': cust.segment == 'BPD'
                    }">
                {{cust.segment}}
              </span>
            </div>
            
            <div class="clm-search-card-body">
              <div class="clm-search-card-row">
                <span class="clm-search-card-label">Code:</span>
                <span class="clm-search-card-value">{{cust.customer_code_sap}}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="clm-search-card-row">
                <span class="clm-search-card-label">Type:</span>
                <span class="clm-search-card-value">{{cust.customer_type}}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="clm-search-card-row">
                <span class="clm-search-card-label">Location:</span>
                <span class="clm-search-card-value">{{cust.region}} - {{cust.zone}}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="clm-search-card-row">
                <span class="clm-search-card-label">Current Limit:</span>
                <span class="clm-search-card-value">₹{{cust.current_credit_limit / 100000 | number:2}}L</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            <div class="clm-search-card-footer" ng-if="c.data.selectedCustomerSysId == cust.sys_id">
              <span class="clm-search-selected-icon">✓</span> Selected
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Customer Details (After Selection) -->
      <div class="clm-customer-strip" ng-if="c.data.customerName && c.data.selectedCustomerSysId">
        <div class="clm-strip-item">
          <span class="clm-strip-label">Customer</span>
          <span class="clm-strip-value">{{c.data.customerName}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-strip-item">
          <span class="clm-strip-label">Type</span>
          <span class="clm-strip-value"
                ng-class="{
                  'clm-type-trade':    c.data.customerType == 'Trade',
                  'clm-type-nontrade': c.data.customerType == 'Non-Trade',
                  'clm-type-key':      c.data.customerType == 'Key'
                }">
            {{c.data.customerType || '—'}}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-strip-item">
          <span class="clm-strip-label">Segment</span>
          <span class="clm-strip-value">{{c.data.segment || '—'}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-strip-item">
          <span class="clm-strip-label">Zone</span>
          <span class="clm-strip-value">{{c.data.zone || '—'}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-strip-item">
          <span class="clm-strip-label">Region</span>
          <span class="clm-strip-value">{{c.data.region || '—'}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-strip-item">
          <span class="clm-strip-label">PAN</span>
          <span class="clm-strip-value">{{c.data.pan || '—'}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-strip-item" ng-if="c.data.customerType == 'Trade'">
          <span class="clm-strip-label">CG2 Code</span>
          <span class="clm-strip-value">{{c.data.cg2Code || '—'}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-strip-item">
          <span class="clm-strip-label">Customer Since</span>
          <span class="clm-strip-value">{{c.data.vintageDays}} days</span>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-strip-item">
          <span class="clm-strip-label">Current Limit</span>
          <span class="clm-strip-value">₹{{c.data.currentLimit | number:2}}L</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         SECTION 2A: TRADE — Credit Limit & SD
    ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <div class="clm-section" ng-if="c.data.customerType == 'Trade' && c.data.selectedCustomerSysId">
      <div class="clm-section-title">
        <span class="clm-section-num">2</span> Credit Limit & Security Deposit
      </div>

      <div class="clm-row">
        <div class="clm-field">
          <label>Active Security Deposit (₹) <span class="req">*</span></label>
          <input type="number" ng-model="c.data.activeSD"
                 class="clm-input" min="0" readonly />
        </div>

        <div class="clm-field">
          <label>Requested Credit Limit (₹) <span class="req">*</span></label>
          <input type="number" ng-model="c.data.requestedLimit"
                 ng-change="c.recalculate()" class="clm-input" min="0" required />
        </div>

        <div class="clm-field">
          <label>Current Outstanding (₹)</label>
          <input type="number" ng-model="c.data.outstanding"
                 class="clm-input" min="0" readonly />
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="clm-row clm-field-hint" 
           ng-if="c.data.activeSD || c.data.requestedLimit || c.data.outstanding">
        <div class="clm-field" ng-if="c.data.activeSD">
          Active SD: ₹{{c.data.activeSD / 100000 | number:2}} Lakhs
        </div>
        <div class="clm-field" ng-if="c.data.requestedLimit">
          Requested Limit: ₹{{c.data.requestedLimit / 100000 | number:2}} Lakhs
        </div>
        <div class="clm-field" ng-if="c.data.outstanding">
          Outstanding: ₹{{c.data.outstanding / 100000 | number:2}} Lakhs
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         SECTION 2B: NON-TRADE — Multi-Site Allocation
    ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <div class="clm-section" ng-if="c.data.customerType == 'Non-Trade' && c.data.selectedCustomerSysId">
      <div class="clm-section-title">
        <span class="clm-section-num">2</span> Site-Wise Credit Limit Request
      </div>

      <!-- No Orphan Limit Rule -->
      <div class="clm-alert clm-alert-warning">
        <div class="clm-alert-icon">⚠</div>
        <div class="clm-alert-body">
          <strong>No Orphan Limit Rule</strong><br>
          All requested credit must be allocated to specific sites. Parent-level limits are not allowed. System will prevent submission if total requested ≠ 0.
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Sites Under Your Jurisdiction Table -->
      <div class="clm-sites-panel">
        <div class="clm-sites-header">
          <span class="clm-sites-icon">]]>📍<![CDATA[</span> Sites Under Your Jurisdiction
        </div>

        <div class="clm-sites-table">
          <!-- Header -->
          <div class="clm-sites-table-header">
            <div class="clm-sites-col-depot">Depot</div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-site">Site Code</div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-location">Location</div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-limit">Current Limit</div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-outstanding">Outstanding</div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-project">Project Potential (₹L)</div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-volume">Monthly Volume (₹L)</div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-requested">Requested Limit (₹L)</div>
          </div>

          <!-- Rows -->
          <div ng-repeat="site in c.data.sites" class="clm-sites-table-row">
            <div class="clm-sites-col-depot">{{site.depot}}</div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-site">
              <strong>{{site.site_code}}</strong>
            </div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-location">{{site.location}}</div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-limit">₹{{site.current_limit / 100000 | number:2}}L</div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-outstanding">₹{{site.outstanding / 100000 | number:2}}L</div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-project">
              <input type="number" 
                     ng-model="site.project_potential"
                     class="clm-sites-input"
                     min="0"
                     placeholder="12121" />
            </div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-volume">
              <input type="number" 
                     ng-model="site.monthly_volume"
                     class="clm-sites-input"
                     min="0"
                     placeholder="112" />
            </div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-requested">
              <input type="number" 
                     ng-model="site.requested_limit"
                     ng-change="c.recalculateSites()"
                     class="clm-sites-input clm-sites-input-highlight"
                     min="0"
                     placeholder="100"
                     required />
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Totals Row -->
          <div class="clm-sites-totals-row">
            <div class="clm-sites-col-depot"></div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-site"><strong>Total</strong></div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-location"></div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-limit"></div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-outstanding"></div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-project"></div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-volume"></div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-requested">
              <strong>₹{{c.data.sitesTotalRequested | number:2}}L</strong>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Consolidated Request Summary -->
      <div class="clm-consolidated-summary">
        <div class="clm-consolidated-title">
          ]]>📊<![CDATA[ Consolidated Request Summary
        </div>
        <div class="clm-consolidated-grid">
          <div class="clm-consolidated-item">
            <div class="clm-consolidated-label">Number of Sites Selected:</div>
            <div class="clm-consolidated-value">{{c.data.sitesCount}}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="clm-consolidated-item clm-consolidated-item-highlight">
            <div class="clm-consolidated-label">Total Requested Limit:</div>
            <div class="clm-consolidated-value">₹{{c.data.sitesTotalRequested | number:2}}L</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Approval Routing Preview -->
      <div class="clm-approval-preview" ng-if="c.data.sitesTotalRequested > 0">
        <div class="clm-approval-title">
          ]]>🔄<![CDATA[ Approval Routing Preview
        </div>
        <div class="clm-approval-body">
          Based on Total Request: <strong>₹{{c.data.sitesTotalRequested | number:2}}L</strong>
          <div class="clm-approval-flow">
            <span class="clm-approval-role">TSH</span>
            <span class="clm-approval-arrow">→</span>
            <span class="clm-approval-role clm-approval-role-highlight">RHM</span>
            <span class="clm-approval-arrow">→</span>
            <span class="clm-approval-role">ZHO</span>
          </div>
          <div class="clm-approval-note">
            * Routing determined by consolidated request amount
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Validation Error -->
      <div class="clm-alert clm-alert-danger" ng-if="c.data.sitesValidationError">
        <div class="clm-alert-icon">✗</div>
        <div class="clm-alert-body">{{c.data.sitesValidationError}}</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         LIVE CALCULATION PANEL — TRADE
    ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <div class="clm-calc-panel"
         ng-if="c.data.customerType == 'Trade' && c.data.activeSD > 0 && c.data.requestedLimit > 0">
      <div class="clm-calc-title">Live Calculation</div>
      <div class="clm-calc-grid">
        <div class="clm-calc-card">
          <div class="clm-calc-label">System Multiplier</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-value">{{c.data.calc.multiplier || '—'}}x</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-sub">Based on {{c.data.vintageDays}} days vintage</div>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-calc-card">
          <div class="clm-calc-label">Max Allowable</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-value">₹{{c.data.calc.maxAllowable | number:2}}L</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-sub">SD × Multiplier</div>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-calc-card">
          <div class="clm-calc-label">Net Exposure</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-value">₹{{c.data.calc.netExposure | number:2}}L</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-sub">Requested − SD</div>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-calc-card">
          <div class="clm-calc-label">Implied Multiplier</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-value"
               ng-class="c.data.calc.isDeviation ? 'clm-val-danger' : 'clm-val-ok'">
            {{c.data.calc.impliedMult | number:2}}x
          </div>
          <div class="clm-calc-sub">Requested ÷ SD</div>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-calc-card">
          <div class="clm-calc-label">Approver</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-value clm-val-approver">{{c.data.calc.approverRole || '—'}}</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-sub" ng-if="c.data.calc.escalated" style="color:#e74c3c">
            ↑ Escalated
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-calc-card">
          <div class="clm-calc-label">Aging Rating</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-value"
               ng-class="{
                 'clm-val-ok':     c.data.calc.agingRating == 'A',
                 'clm-val-warn':   c.data.calc.agingRating == 'B',
                 'clm-val-danger': c.data.calc.agingRating == 'C'
               }">
            {{c.data.calc.agingRating || '—'}}
          </div>
          <div class="clm-calc-sub">6-month history</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="clm-alert clm-alert-danger" ng-if="c.data.calc.isDeviation">
        <div class="clm-alert-icon">⚠</div>
        <div class="clm-alert-body">
          <strong>Deviation</strong> — Implied {{c.data.calc.impliedMult | number:2}}x exceeds system {{c.data.calc.multiplier}}x. Higher approval required.
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="clm-alert clm-alert-success" ng-if="!c.data.calc.isDeviation">
        <div class="clm-alert-icon">✓</div>
        <div class="clm-alert-body"><strong>Within Limits</strong> — Routes to <strong>{{c.data.calc.approverRole}}</strong></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         SECTION 3: BUSINESS JUSTIFICATION
    ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <div class="clm-section" ng-if="c.data.selectedCustomerSysId">
      <div class="clm-section-title">
        <span class="clm-section-num">3</span> Business Justification <span class="req">*</span>
      </div>
      <textarea ng-model="c.data.justification"
                class="clm-textarea" rows="4"
                placeholder="Explain the business reason for this credit limit request..."
                required></textarea>

      <div ng-if="c.data.calc.isDeviation" style="margin-top:12px">
        <label style="font-weight:600;color:#c0392b">
          Deviation Justification <span class="req">*</span>
          <small>(Required — request exceeds safe limit)</small>
        </label>
        <textarea ng-model="c.data.deviationJustification"
                  class="clm-textarea clm-textarea-danger" rows="3"
                  placeholder="Explain why the requested limit exceeds the calculated safe limit..."
                  ng-required="c.data.calc.isDeviation"></textarea>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ERROR -->
    <div class="clm-alert clm-alert-danger" ng-if="c.data.submitError">
      <div class="clm-alert-icon">✗</div>
      <div class="clm-alert-body">{{c.data.submitError}}</div>
    </div>

    <!-- ACTIONS -->
    <div class="clm-actions" ng-if="c.data.selectedCustomerSysId">
      <button type="button" class="clm-btn clm-btn-outline"
              ng-click="c.saveDraft()" ng-disabled="c.data.saving">
        {{c.data.saving ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Draft'}}
      </button>
      <button type="submit" class="clm-btn clm-btn-primary"
              ng-disabled="clmForm.$invalid || c.data.submitting || !c.data.selectedCustomerSysId">
        {{c.data.submitting ? 'Submitting...' : 'Submit for Approval'}}
      </button>
    </div>

  </form>
</div>
